summary: Nexxen International Ltd. (NASDAQ: NEXN) filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, reporting its Q2 2026 financial results and announcing a management change: Chance Johnson was promoted from Chief Commercial Officer to President. The filing includes unaudited interim financial statements incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 registration statements. Revenue metrics include record contribution ex-TAC of $97.8 million and programmatic revenue of $95.2 million. This is a routine earnings announcement with a personnel promotion, not a special situation. No transaction, deal, or strategic event is disclosed. The management change is promotional, not abrupt or forced. Category None.
